YOUR PRIVACY • OUR RESPONSIBILITY

Starblast Project does not seek to steal, expose, or misuse visitors' IP addresses or private data. Your privacy and security matter to our team. We are committed to protecting users and taking any reported security concern seriously.

EOT does not display players' personal IP addresses. A direct Starblast Join Game link may contain the game server's public address — not a player's personal IP. Use SHARE MATCH to share an EOT website link instead.

Hosting providers and external services may process technical connection data. If you notice a privacy or security issue, please contact our team so it can be investigated. Community match information may be incomplete, and clan tags are based on nicknames, not verified memberships.
